title: Client Extensions and Middleware
description: Extend Prisma Client with custom methods, query hooks, computed fields, and automated soft delete filtering using Prisma Client Extensions.

data.text: Prisma Client Extensions (`$extends`) is the modern, type-safe API that supersedes legacy middleware (`$use`). Extensions allow you to hook into queries, add custom model methods, compute virtual fields on the fly, and transform client behavior while preserving 100% TypeScript type inference.
The Four Types of Client Extensions

rows: Adds custom methods to specific models
Adds global methods to the entire Prisma Client
Intercepts and modifies query arguments or results
Adds virtual/computed fields to returned records

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use Prisma Client Extensions (`$extends`) instead of deprecated `$use` middleware.
`result` extensions add computed fields that appear directly in TypeScript autocomplete.
`query` hooks allow implementing global soft-deletes and auditing transparently.
